about: Announced datacenters: what a named project's own government or company document said it would bring, one row a project and a document, every figure with the document's own words. Transcribed by hand by chain 740 (lab-desktop window 3) from documents read on 26 November 2026; no model API. `request` is the row of runs/c740/probe/probe.csv on lab-desktop (bodies kept under runs/c740/reads/, not in git). `says` is the phrase that states the figure, inside `quote`; warehouse/forecast/datacenter_announced.py checks both against the kept text and parses `says` to `value`. A figure the document does not state is null, never filled.

rows.name: Meta, Richland Parish data center

doc.title: Meta Selects Northeast Louisiana as Site of $10 Billion Artificial Intelligence Optimized Data Center

investment.quote: Facebook and Instagram parent company Meta announced it will build a $10 billion artificial intelligence data center in northeast Louisiana

construction_jobs.quote: The company estimates 5,000 construction workers at peak of construction

permanent_jobs.quote: Meta projects the data center will support 500 or more direct new jobs in Richland Parish.

rows.incentive: The company is expected to take advantage of a new Louisiana incentive program, established by Act 730, that offers qualifying projects a state and local sales and use tax rebate on the purchase or lease of data center equipment.
rows.years: Meta expects construction to continue through 2030 with site work beginning in December.
